name: Echo CS-3510
blurb: 34.4 cc saw. Echo's bars chart: 14″ and 16″, 3/8″ low profile, .050″, 52 and 57 drive links (91PX). The spec table's listed bar is 16″.
intro: The CS-3510 is a 34.4 cc rear-handle saw. Echo's specification table lists a 16″ bar. The Bars and Chains chart prints two CS-3510 rows, both 91PX, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 5/32″ file: 52 drive links on 14″ (bar 14A0CD3752C) and 57 on 16″ (bar 16A0CD3757C). Both are on this page because the bars chart names the CS-3510 on each of them. The 16″ row is the one the specification table lists.

bars.note: Echo bar 14A0CD3752C; chain 91PX52CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. On the CS-3510 bars-chart row. Echo's specification table lists the bar length as 16″.
Echo bar 16A0CD3757C; chain 91PX57CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. This is the bar length in Echo's specification table for the CS-3510.
